# Bright field frames, 4K native (3840x2160)

Captured live 2026-10-09 while walking the five event cartridges (PrintWindow
on the game window, no overlay). Each scene has two crops in 4K pixels:

- `*_bottom.png`: x 1400-2400, y 1800-2160 (1080 ref 700-1200 x 900-1080),
  holds the P (quick switch), run and Q discs.
- `*_topright.png`: x 3040-3760, y 0-240 (1080 ref 1520-1880 x 0-120),
  holds the C / I / H key caps.
- `*_full.jpg`: whole frame (JPEG q85) for the four brightest scenes.

Brightest: beach_* (white sand glare), splash_safe_pool, nightmare_battle*_lights
(fairy lights next to the P disc). No `cartridge_quick_switch_failed`
diagnostic existed in the installed tool's probe_outputs on this date.
